info.title: RelayShield
info.description: Identity threat intelligence for security and IT operations. Check whether an email, phone number, domain, vendor or IP has been exposed in a breach, an infostealer log, a SIM swap or a criminal marketplace, and act on the result inside your existing flows.

post.summary: Check an email for data breach exposure
post.description:
Looks the address up across 13B+ compromised accounts and returns every breach it appears in, with the date and the classes of data exposed. Call it before trusting a new user identity or granting elevated access.

**Billing.** $0.10 per successful call. Failed calls are never billed. Charged against prepaid credits when the balance covers it, otherwise metered to your card. Threat Intelligence subscribers and AWS Marketplace bundle customers call this at no extra charge.

email.description: Email address to check. Case-insensitive; whitespace is trimmed. Must contain '@'.
The normalised address that was checked.

record_type.description: Always `credential_exposure`. Lets a SIEM route every identity finding on one field.

breach_count.description: Number of breaches the address appears in. 0 means no known exposure.

domain.description: Domain of the breached service. May be empty.

is_verified.description: Whether the breach has been verified as genuine.

post.summary: Check a phone number for a recent SIM swap
post.description:
Queries live carrier data for the number. A recent swap is a strong signal of an account-takeover attempt against SMS-based 2FA, so call this before trusting an SMS OTP from a number you have not seen before.

**Billing.** $0.25 per successful call. Failed calls are never billed. Charged against prepaid credits when the balance covers it, otherwise metered to your card. Threat Intelligence subscribers and AWS Marketplace bundle customers call this at no extra charge.

phone.description: Phone number in E.164 format. Must start with '+'. Rejected without it -- national formats are ambiguous across carriers.
The number that was checked, echoed as supplied.

swap_timestamp.description: When the swap occurred. Empty string when no swap is reported.

carrier.description: Current carrier name. Empty when the carrier does not disclose it.

post.summary: Find lookalike domains impersonating a domain
post.description:
Generates typosquat, homoglyph and phishing-prefix permutations, keeps the ones that actually resolve, then enriches each with Safe Browsing status, registration age and Certificate Transparency activity. post.summary: Score vendor domains for third-party breach risk
post.description:
One call covers up to 10 vendor domains. Each gets a breach and infostealer assessment plus a 0-100 dark-web composite; results come back sorted worst-first.

**Billing.** $0.10 per successful call. Failed calls are never billed. Charged against prepaid credits when the balance covers it, otherwise metered to your card. Threat Intelligence subscribers and AWS Marketplace bundle customers call this at no extra charge.

post.summary: Scan text for leaked API keys and credentials
post.description:
Pattern-scans content you send, with no external lookups. Built for pre-commit hooks and CI: send a unified diff and only added lines are scanned, so pre-existing secrets in a file do not block every commit that touches it. Priced well below secret-scan because this fires on every commit.

**Billing.** $0.05 per successful call. Failed calls are never billed. Charged against prepaid credits when the balance covers it, otherwise metered to your card. Threat Intelligence subscribers and AWS Mar...

file.description: The `filename` you supplied, or the path parsed from the diff.

post.summary: Check an email for stolen active session cookies
post.description:
Searches criminal stealer-log archives for live session cookies belonging to the address. This is the AiTM case that password rotation does not fix: a stolen cookie bypasses 2FA and stays valid until the session is explicitly invalidated.

post.summary: Get a combined identity risk score for an email
post.description:
A security credit score for any domain: breach exposure, infostealer density, IOC corpus presence, ransomware victim listing, active session exposure and CVE exposure. Returns the per-dimension breakdown as well as the total, so the score is auditable rather than a black box. MSPs embed this in QBRs, insurance renewals and onboarding assessments.

**Billing.** $0.35 per successful call. Failed calls are never billed. Charged against prepaid credits when the balance covers it, otherwise metere...

post.summary: Check TLS certificate expiry for a domain
post.description:
Reads Certificate Transparency logs and reports days remaining on the certificate most likely deployed right now (the unexpired entry with the latest not_before). Relevant as CA/Browser Forum rules shrink standard certificate lifetimes toward 47 days by 2029.

**Billing.** $0.05 per successful call. Failed calls are never billed. Charged against prepaid credits when the balance covers it, otherwise metered to your card. Threat Intelligence subscribers and AWS Marketplace bundle customers call...

post.summary: Check a BIN or card range for carding-market exposure
post.description:
Pass a client-computed SHA-256 of the digit-only card number, a 6-8 digit BIN, or both. RelayShield never accepts or stores a raw card number, and a rejected value is never logged.

**Billing.** $0.30 per successful call. Failed calls are never billed. Charged against prepaid credits when the balance covers it, otherwise metered to your card. Threat Intelligence subscribers and AWS Marketplace bundle customers call this at no extra charge.

pan_hash.description: 64-character lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the digit-only card number (no spaces, no dashes). Computed client-side.

card_exposed.description: True when the exact card hash is in the corpus. Present only when pan_hash was supplied.

last4.description: Last 4 digits of the exposed card. Present only on a pan_hash hit.

first_seen.description: When the card was first seen. Present only on a pan_hash hit.

bin_exposed_card_count.description: Exposed cards sharing this BIN. Present only when bin was supplied.

bin_last_seen.description: Most recent sighting for this BIN. null when none.

post.description:
Pass a domain for its historical IP resolutions, or an IP for reverse resolutions, AS owner and country. RelayShield's own IOC corpus is consulted first; a hit there is a stronger signal than a third-party vote count and short-circuits the external lookup.
